activation_conditions: The host selects OKRs (Objectives & Key Results) to address an identified analytical gap, or the user explicitly requests it. Skip when prior host analysis is sufficient.

methodology: Define measurable key results with baseline, target, owner and deadline

Provide indicators or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
